high jump: He won the high jump at the school sports meeting last week.
他在上周的学校运动会上赢得了跳高比赛。
hurdling: Hurdling requires both speed and good timing over each barrier.
跨栏运动既需要速度，也需要跨过每个栏架的良好时机把握。
sportswoman: She is an excellent sportswoman who has won many national medals.
她是一位出色的女运动员，赢得过许多全国性奖牌。
hurdles: He knocked down two hurdles during the race but still finished second.
他在比赛中撞倒了两道栏架，但仍获得了第二名。
sportsperson: A good sportsperson should train hard and respect the rules.
一名优秀的运动员应该刻苦训练并尊重规则。
suffer from: Many students suffer from stress before the important exams.
许多学生在重要考试前饱受压力之苦。
first place: She practiced every day and finally took first place in the competition.
她每天练习，最终在比赛中获得第一名。
Nothing could stop him from chasing his dream of becoming a pilot.
没有什么能阻止他追逐成为飞行员的梦想。
instructions: Read the instructions carefully before you take the medicine.
服药之前请仔细阅读用法说明。
printing: The printing of this new book was finished in just three days.
这本新书的印刷只用了三天就完成了。
at a time: Please answer the questions one at a time, not all together.
请一次回答一个问题，不要一起回答。
by hand: Grandma still makes all her dumplings by hand.
奶奶仍然用手包所有的饺子。
in a way: In a way, failing that test helped me study harder.
在某种程度上，那次考试不及格促使我更加努力地学习。
compare ⋯ to: Teachers often compare the brain to a powerful computer.
老师们常把大脑比作一台功能强大的计算机。
wait and see: We don't know the results yet, so we'll just have to wait and see.
我们还不知道结果，所以只能等等看。
here we go: Here we go — the train is about to leave the station.
我们这就出发——火车马上要离开车站了。
according to: According to the weather report, it will rain tomorrow afternoon.
根据天气预报，明天下午会下雨。
sailing boat: They crossed the lake in a small sailing boat last summer.
去年夏天他们乘一艘小帆船穿过了那个湖。
keep x: Keep the medicine away from young children for safety.
为了安全，要把药放在幼儿接触不到的地方。
keep sb./sth. away: The fence is built to keep wild animals away from the crops.
修建篱笆是为了让野兽远离庄稼。
She cut the dead branch off the tree with a sharp knife.
她用一把锋利的刀把枯枝从树上剪掉。
keep a diary: My teacher suggests that we keep a diary in English every day.
老师建议我们每天用英语写日记。
He brushed the dust off his coat before entering the house.
进屋前他把外套上的灰尘刷掉。
at the time: At the time, nobody realized how important that discovery would be.
那时，没有人意识到那项发现会有多重要。
be surprised at: We were surprised at the rapid change in the weather.
我们对天气的迅速变化感到惊奇。
riding: Riding is a popular activity in the countryside during holidays.
骑马是乡间假期里一项很受欢迎的活动。
you bet: —Will you join us for the picnic tomorrow? —You bet!
——明天你会和我们一起去野餐吗？——当然！
the thing is: The thing is, we don't have enough money to buy the tickets.
问题是，我们没有足够的钱买票。
be in with a chance: If you keep practicing, you'll be in with a chance of winning.
如果你坚持练习，就有机会获胜。
read out: The teacher read out the names of the students who passed the exam.
老师宣读了通过考试的学生的名字。
compared with: Compared with last year, our school has far more clubs now.
与去年相比，我们学校的社团现在多多了。
Wear sunglasses to protect your eyes against the strong sunlight.
戴上太阳镜保护眼睛免受强烈阳光的伤害。
congratulations: Congratulations on winning the first prize in the speech contest!
恭喜你在演讲比赛中获得一等奖！
throw away: Don't throw away those old boxes; we can reuse them.
别扔掉那些旧箱子，我们还可以重复利用。
tons of: She has tons of homework to finish before the weekend.
她周末前有大量作业要完成。
school-leaver: Many school-leavers choose to continue their studies at university.
许多毕业生选择继续上大学深造。
take care: Take care of yourself when you travel alone in a new city.
独自在一个新城市旅行时要照顾好自己。
secondary school: My little brother will start secondary school next September.
我弟弟明年九月就要上中学了。
spare time: In his spare time, he likes painting and playing the guitar.
业余时间，他喜欢画画和弹吉他。
speak up: Don't be shy — speak up so everyone can hear you.
别害羞——大声说，让每个人都能听见。
